title: Check Customer-Defined Calculations (Metrics) in Overall System HMI
summary: Verify the Overall System HMI “Customer-Defined Calculations: Metrics calculated by the customer” area is present and confirm which customer-defined calculation types are displayed: “System statistics”, “Bin statistics”, and “Tipper statistics”.
when_to_use: Use when you need to confirm what customer-defined metric categories are configured/displayed in the Overall System HMI for the current site view.
not_for: Do not use this procedure to troubleshoot AGV faults, tipper faults, or RMS connectivity issues; this procedure only verifies which customer-defined calculation categories are shown in the Overall System HMI.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Open the Overall System HMI and verify the presence of the “Customer-Defined Calculations: Metrics calculated by the customer” section and the listed calculation types.

visual_references.description: Overall System HMI frame showing “Customer-Defined Calculations: Metrics calculated by the customer” and the listed calculation types: “System statistics”, “Bin statistics”, “Tipper statistics”.

steps.title: Open the Overall System HMI screen that contains the “Customer-Defined Calculations” area
steps.purpose: Get to the correct Overall System HMI view so you can verify the customer-defined metrics section and its contents.
steps.instruction: Open the Overall System HMI screen that includes the “Customer-Defined Calculations: Metrics calculated by the customer” area.
steps.expected_result: The Overall System HMI displays a “Customer-Defined Calculations: Metrics calculated by the customer” section.
steps.healthy_condition: The “Customer-Defined Calculations: Metrics calculated by the customer” label/heading is visible on the Overall System HMI.
steps.failure_condition: The “Customer-Defined Calculations” section is not visible on the Overall System HMI screen you are viewing.

actions.label: Navigate to Customer-Defined Calculations area
actions.exact_action: Open the Overall System HMI screen that contains the “Customer-Defined Calculations” area.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the “Customer-Defined Calculations” section is not visible, escalate to support to confirm whether the customer-defined metrics are configured/enabled for the site.

steps.title: Locate the “Customer-Defined Calculations: Metrics calculated by the customer” label/heading
steps.purpose: Confirm you are looking at the correct HMI section before checking the calculation types.
steps.instruction: On the Overall System HMI, locate the “Customer-Defined Calculations: Metrics calculated by the customer” label/heading.
steps.expected_result: The “Customer-Defined Calculations: Metrics calculated by the customer” heading is visible.
steps.healthy_condition: The exact heading text “Customer-Defined Calculations: Metrics calculated by the customer” is visible in the HMI section.
steps.failure_condition: The heading text is not visible (or you are viewing a different Overall System HMI section).

actions.label: Verify heading text
actions.exact_action: Locate the “Customer-Defined Calculations: Metrics calculated by the customer” label/heading.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the “Customer-Defined Calculations” section or the named calculation types are not visible, escalate to support to confirm whether the customer-defined metrics are configured/enabled for the site.
Do not assume missing categories are a fault without confirming the correct Overall System HMI screen is being viewed.

steps.title: Identify which calculation types are listed under the customer-defined calculations area
steps.purpose: Determine which customer-defined metric categories are currently displayed in the HMI.
steps.instruction: Under the “Customer-Defined Calculations: Metrics calculated by the customer” area, identify the listed calculation types.
steps.expected_result: The calculation types shown include “System statistics”, “Bin statistics”, and “Tipper statistics”.
steps.healthy_condition: All three calculation types—“System statistics”, “Bin statistics”, and “Tipper statistics”—are listed under the customer-defined calculations area.
steps.failure_condition: One or more of the calculation types (“System statistics”, “Bin statistics”, “Tipper statistics”) are not listed under the customer-defined calculations area.

actions.label: Check listed calculation types
actions.exact_action: Identify which calculation types are listed under the customer-defined calculations area: “System statistics”, “Bin statistics”, and “Tipper statistics”.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the “Customer-Defined Calculations” section or the named calculation types are not visible, escalate to support to confirm whether the customer-defined metrics are configured/enabled for the site.
Do not assume missing categories are a fault without confirming the correct Overall System HMI screen is being viewed.

steps.title: Confirm the displayed customer-defined metrics correspond to the named categories
steps.purpose: Ensure the HMI content under each category matches the expected customer-defined calculation categories.
steps.instruction: Confirm that the displayed customer-defined metrics are grouped under the named categories: “System statistics”, “Bin statistics”, and “Tipper statistics”.
steps.expected_result: The HMI shows customer-defined metric content grouped under “System statistics”, “Bin statistics”, and “Tipper statistics”.
steps.healthy_condition: Each named category has visible metric content/rows/tiles (if present in the HMI frame) under it, consistent with the category label.
steps.failure_condition: The HMI shows the categories but the metric content is missing/mismatched, or the categories are not grouped as expected.

actions.label: Verify category-to-metrics mapping
actions.exact_action: Confirm that the displayed customer-defined metrics correspond to the named categories (system statistics / bin statistics / tipper statistics) as shown on the HMI.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the “Customer-Defined Calculations” section or the named calculation types are not visible, escalate to support to confirm whether the customer-defined metrics are configured/enabled for the site.
Do not assume missing categories are a fault without confirming the correct Overall System HMI screen is being viewed.

success_criteria: Overall System HMI shows the “Customer-Defined Calculations: Metrics calculated by the customer” section.
The calculation types listed include “System statistics”, “Bin statistics”, and “Tipper statistics”.
healthy_conditions: The “Customer-Defined Calculations: Metrics calculated by the customer” heading is visible.
The HMI lists “System statistics”, “Bin statistics”, and “Tipper statistics” under the customer-defined calculations area.
failure_conditions: The “Customer-Defined Calculations” section is not visible on the Overall System HMI screen.
One or more expected calculation types (“System statistics”, “Bin statistics”, “Tipper statistics”) are not listed under the customer-defined calculations area.
escalation_guidance: If the “Customer-Defined Calculations” section or the named calculation types are not visible, escalate to support to confirm whether the customer-defined metrics are configured/enabled for the site.
Do not assume missing categories are a fault without confirming the correct Overall System HMI screen is being viewed.
